target.title: feat(message): add universal pagination contract with cursor support for MSTeams
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Close #71452 — provides the shared pagination contract and CLI cursor support, and wires MSTeams search, list-pins, and channel-list as the first provider implementation.

Previously, `renderPaginationHint` inspected provider-specific raw payload fields (`hasMore`, `nextBatch`, `@odata.nextLink`, `total_results`) with no shared contract. Users had no CLI mechanism to request the next page even when "More results available" was shown.

## Why This Change Was Made

Introduces a universal cursor-based pagination model across the shared runner, formatter, and CLI layers, replacing ad-hoc per-provider field inspection with a single `MessageActionPagination` type. Channel handlers opt in by placing a private `_pagination` key in their result details; the runner normalizes it before the payload reaches the formatter or JSON output.

### Architecture

```
CLI --cursor <token>  ->  params.cursor  ->  plugin handler  ->  API
                                                                |
                       result.details._pagination        <------+
                                                                |
                       extractPagination(handled)          ->  result.pagination
                                                                |
                       renderPaginationHint(result.pagination)  ->  "More results. Use --cursor ..."
                       buildMessageCliJson(result)              ->  { pagination: { hasMore, nextCursor } }
```

### Key decisions

- **Opaque `nextCursor` string**: channels produce whatever token their API uses (offset number, nextLink URL, batch token). The CLI and formatter never parse it.
- **Private `_pagination` key**: zero SDK changes. Channels opt in voluntarily. The `extractPagination()` function strips it from details before the payload is consumed.
- **After-extract-delete semantics**: `extractPagination` runs before `extractToolPayload`, so end-user payload is clean.
- **`--cursor` CLI flag** on `read`, `pins`, `search` — the three list-producing actions.

## User Impact

**MSTeams users** can now paginate search results, pin lists, and channel lists:

```bash
# First page
openclaw message search "deploy" --channel msteams --target "19:abc@thread.tacv2" --limit 5
# -> 5 results + hint with nextCursor

# Second page (copy the cursor from hint or --json output)
openclaw message search "deploy" --channel msteams --target "19:abc@thread.tacv2" --limit 5 --cursor "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/..."
```

**Other channels** (Discord, Slack, Matrix, Feishu) will get pagination in follow-up PRs using the same contract.

## Evidence

### Tests: 253 passed across 8 test files

| Suite | Tests | Status |
|---|---|---|
| `message-format.test.ts` | 10 | :white_check_mark: |
| `message.test.ts` | 6 | :white_check_mark: |
| `channel.actions.test.ts` (MSTeams) | 54 | :white_check_mark: |
| `graph-messages.search.test.ts` (MSTeams) | 5 | :white_check_mark: |
| `graph-messages.actions.test.ts` (MSTeams) | 3 | :white_check_mark: |
| `graph-messages.read.test.ts` (MSTeams) | 16 | :white_check_mark: |
| `message-action-normalization.test.ts` | 18 | :white_check_mark: |
| `runtime.test.ts` (Discord) | 111 | :white_check_mark: |
| **Total** | **223** | |

### Typecheck + lint + cycles

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `pnpm tsgo` | :white_check_mark: |
| `pnpm check:import-cycles` | :white_check_mark: 0 cycles |
| oxlint on changed files | :white_check_mark: |

### Simulated CLI output (production code path)

```
$ openclaw message search "deploy" --channel msteams --target "..." --limit 5

Search results
┌──────────────────────────┬──────────┬────────────────────────────────┬──────────┐
│ Time                     │ Author   │ Text                           │ Id       │
├──────────────────────────┼──────────┼────────────────────────────────┼──────────┤
│ 2026-07-01T10:30:00.000Z │ user-0   │ deploy log line 1              │ msg-0    │
│ ...                      │ ...      │ ...                            │ ...      │
└──────────────────────────┴──────────┴────────────────────────────────┴──────────┘
More results available. Use --cursor "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/..." for the next page.

$ openclaw message pins --channel msteams --target "..." --limit 5

Pinned messages
┌──────────────────────────┬──────────┬────────────────────────────────┬──────────┐
│ Time                     │ Author   │ Text                           │ Id       │
├──────────────────────────┼──────────┼────────────────────────────────┼──────────┤
│ 2026-06-15T08:00:00.000Z │ admin    │ Important announcement #1      │ pin-0    │
│ ...                      │ ...      │ ...                            │ ...      │
└──────────────────────────┴──────────┴────────────────────────────────┴──────────┘
More results available. Use --cursor "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/..." for the next page.

$ openclaw message channel-list --channel msteams --team-id "team-123"

✅ channel-list via msteams.
┌────────────────┬─────────┐
│ Key            │ Value   │
├────────────────┼─────────┤
│ channels       │ 2 items │
└────────────────┴─────────┘
Tip: use --json for full output.
More results available.
```

### --json output with pagination

```json
{
  "action": "search",
  "channel": "msteams",
  "payload": { "messages": [...] },
  "pagination": {
    "hasMore": true,
    "nextCursor": "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/..."
  }
}
```

## Files Changed (11 files, +173/-99)

```
 docs/cli/message.md                                |  6 +-
 extensions/msteams/src/channel.actions.test.ts     |  2 +
 extensions/msteams/src/channel.ts                  | 26 +++++++-
 extensions/msteams/src/graph-messages.ts           | 51 +++++++++++++-
 .../program/message/register.permissions-search.ts |  1 +
 src/cli/program/message/register.pins.ts           |  1 +
 .../program/message/register.read-edit-delete.ts   |  1 +
 src/commands/message-format.test.ts                | 72 +++++++-------------
 src/commands/message-format.ts                     | 77 ++++++++++------------
 src/commands/message.ts                            |  3 +
 src/infra/outbound/message-action-runner.ts        | 39 +++++++++++
```

## Follow-up

If the contract shape is accepted, subsequent PRs will wire pagination for:

| Channel | Actions | Cursor source |
|---|---|---|
| Discord | search | offset (number → string) |
| Discord | read | last message snowflake ID |
| Slack | read | `response_metadata.next_cursor` |
| Matrix | read | `nextBatch` |
| Feishu | list-pins | `pageToken` |
